title: Topological, metric and fractal properties of one family of self-similar sets
summary: Depending on a natural parameter $l$, we study the topological, metric, and fractal properties of the homogeneous self-similar set $$K_{l}=\left\{\sum_{i=1}^{\infty} \frac{\varepsilon_i}{(2l+2)^i} : (\varepsilon_i) \in \{0, 2, 4, \dots, 2l, 2l+1, 2l+3, \dots, 4l+1 \}^{\mathbb{N}} \right\}.$$ In particular, we prove that $K_l$ is a Cantorval, a perfect set on the real line with a non-empty interior and fractal boundary. Additionally, we show that $K_l$ has Lebesgue measure $1$ and that its boundary has Hausdorff dimension $\log(2l+1)/\log(2l+2)$.
